event_title: Enemy Contact Near FSB Fontaine — April 20, 1971
intro_shared: On April 20, 1971, D Company suffered significant casualties in contact near FSB Fontaine. Much of what happened that day has never been fully recorded. If you were with D Company on April 20–23, 1971, your account — whatever you can share — is an important part of this record.

intro_by_platoon.skull: Skull Platoon was called in as reinforcement and arrived that afternoon, helping reconstitute the company's strength and hold the perimeter through the night. If you were with Skull Platoon on April 20–23, 1971, your account of those days is one that only you can give.
intro_by_platoon.cat: Cat Platoon held the south bank of the stream while Range was engaged on the north bank. What Cat could see, hear, and do from that position — and what happened when Range withdrew across the stream — is an important and distinct part of this record.
intro_by_platoon.range:
Range Platoon walked into an NVA ambush near a stream in Long Khanh Province. What followed — the contact, the firefight, the withdrawal, and the night that came after — has been partially documented through a handful of accounts. But much of what happened that day has never been recorded. If you were with Range Platoon on that patrol, your account is a central part of this record.

If you were with Range Platoon but not on the patrol that day, contact us here to share what you remember.
